description: TT - TDB from the INPOP21a time ephemeris, from 1900 to 2100 every 10 days, plus 1977-01-01 and 2100-01-01, built by bin/inpop_fixture. Each case is a TDB Julian Date and TT - TDB at that date, in seconds. The ephemeris is indexed by TDB, and its sign is opposite to Horologium::Data::BarycentricModel.tdb_minus_tt. The values are rounded to the picosecond.
